text: 9月16日，A股市场迎来大反攻，通信、半导体概念股集体爆发。在A股近期的震荡调整行情中，资金借道ETF逆势大幅流入硬科技板块。Wind数据显示，近一个月（8月17日~9月15日），科创50、通信、芯片半导体、人工智能相关主题ETF合计吸金约450亿元。（每经）
text_en: On September 16, the A-share market staged a major rebound, with communications and semiconductor concept stocks surging collectively. During the A-share market's recent volatile correction, funds flowed significantly into hard-tech sectors through ETFs against the trend. Wind data shows that over the past month (August 17 to September 15), ETFs related to STAR 50, communications, chips and semiconductors, and artificial intelligence attracted a total of about RMB 45 billion. (National Business Daily)
